title: Shah Rukh Khan's King Enters Final Shooting Phase With Last International Schedule Set for August
excerpt: The Rs 350 crore action thriller, which also stars Suhana Khan and Abhishek Bachchan, will wrap its climax sequence in the US and South America before heading into post-production for a December 2026 release.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Shah Rukh Khan's film King is in its final production phase, with shooting in August 2026.
  • Director Siddharth Anand seeks unique locations for the film's climax, aiming for a distinctive visual identity.
  • King features Suhana Khan's big-screen debut alongside stars like Deepika Padukone and Abhishek Bachchan.
  • With a budget of Rs 350 crore, King is touted as India's most expensive action film.
  • The film is set for a theatrical release in December 2026, competing with major holiday films.
  • Shah Rukh Khan's action thriller King is entering its final phase of production, with the last international schedule planned for August 2026 in the US and South America
  • Director Siddharth Anand is scouting visually distinctive locations for the film's climax sequence, seeking backdrops never before seen in Indian cinema
  • The film also stars Suhana Khan in her big-screen debut alongside Deepika Padukone, Abhishek Bachchan, and Abhay Verma
  • King is targeting a theatrical release in December 2026 and is reportedly India's most expensive action film at Rs 350 crore

Shah Rukh Khan's much-anticipated action thriller King is nearing the finish line. According to multiple reports, director Siddharth Anand has just one final international shooting schedule remaining before the film wraps principal photography and moves into post-production.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=Uu2QK9Z9X5E

The last sequence will be filmed across locations in the United States and South America, with the shoot set for August 2026, according to Bollywood Life and The Times of India. A location scouting team is already on the ground in the US, evaluating sites and handling logistics.

A Climax Built Around a Never-Before-Seen Backdrop

Anand and Khan are reportedly determined to close the film on a visually spectacular note. Rather than relying on familiar international locations, the director has instructed his team to find a setting that would give King its own visual identity.

https://x.com/khaama/status/2079475126006137147 > **"Earlier reports from Bollywood Hungama had indicated that Budapest, Prague, and Berlin were shortlisted for chase sequences during an earlier schedule."**

"Siddharth wants these sequences to be stunning and has told his team to scout for some never-before-seen locales."

— Source close to the production, via Mid-Day

The production had previously filmed across India, the UAE, and Europe. Earlier reports from Bollywood Hungama had indicated that Budapest, Prague, and Berlin were shortlisted for chase sequences during an earlier schedule. The US and South America leg will focus on the film's climax.

India's Most Expensive Action Film

King has been described as India's costliest action film, with an estimated budget of Rs 350 crore. The project features six major action sequences designed to set a new standard for the genre in Indian cinema, according to Bollywood Hungama.

The film marks a reunion between Khan and Anand, who previously delivered the blockbuster Pathaan in 2023, Anand took over as director after Sujoy Ghosh, who was initially attached to the project, stepped aside. Anand reworked the script to create what the production team has described as a larger-than-life cinematic experience.

Suhana Khan's Big-Screen Debut

King will serve as the theatrical debut for Suhana Khan, who previously appeared in Zoya Akhtar's The Archies on Netflix. She joins an ensemble that includes Deepika Padukone, Abhishek Bachchan, Rani Mukerji, Abhay Verma, and Jaideep Ahlawat.

The father-daughter pairing of Shah Rukh and Suhana Khan has generated considerable buzz, with the film positioned as both a tentpole action release and a marquee launch for the younger Khan.

![Suhana Khan. King features Suhana Khan's big-screen debut alongside stars like Deepika Padukone and Abhishek Bachchan.](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/4/45/The_Archies_film_poster.jpg)

December Release Window

Following the overseas shoot, King will enter post-production with a targeted theatrical release in December 2026. The year-end window places it in direct competition with other major holiday releases, but Khan's track record with Pathaan and Jawan suggests the film will command significant screen real estate.

For Indian audiences worldwide, the countdown to King now hinges on a single question: whether the final sequence delivers the visual spectacle that Anand and Khan have promised.
